lines.text: [excited] You know that one little app you wish existed? Jig makes it. From one sentence.
Like... my houseplants. Each one on its own watering schedule.
[curious] Muse Spark is designing it right now. Screens, data, a nine a.m. reminder. And when something doesn't check out? [impressed] It fixes itself.
[delighted] And there it is. A real native app, on iPhone and Android. Same app, both phones.
The fern's thirsty! Jig will nudge me at nine, even with the app closed.
Want something changed? Tap it, and just say it.
[impressed] It edits just that part, then checks its own work.
[playful] Now, apps that talk to each other.
A shopping list that reads my pantry. For the tricky part, it even writes a little script, and Jig runs it safely in a sandbox.
It asks before peeking at another app's data. Then whatever's running low just shows up.
And yes, your apps can use Meta's AI too.
What's in my fridge? Three dinners, thirty minutes. And my API key never even touches the app.
[warmly] Describe it. Use it. Change it. That's Jig.
